prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-quality art-direction comparison board: three equally sized tall 2:3 panels side by side, no letters or labels. Each panel depicts a distinct composition for a mature, richly developed island home world for the Japanese children's learning app Pokomoko. NOT an app UI. No text, numbers, menus, badges, game currency, screens, or promotional logo.
Reference 1 is the exact identity of the hero Pokomoko: a small plump patchwork teddy bear, ivory viewer-left face/cobalt viewer-right face with yellow center stitches, navy left ear with cream dots and rose-pink right ear with cream dots, cream muzzle, dark bead eyes/nose, turquoise/pink sleeves and ivory/navy striped plus golden cloth torso. Extend that identity into short stuffed legs. ONLY this hero bear, do not substitute a brown bear or otter.
Reference 2 is MATERIAL/PALETTE/SHORE inspiration only: bright cobalt-turquoise water, lavender purple broad tree crowns, rounded colorful tile roof, warm creamy house, handmade model materials. Do NOT reproduce its text/UI/duplicated panels or make its otter the hero.
All three panels must evoke 'I want to grow MY home into this wonderful place'. Hero at home threshold, house is largest most emotionally important building, naturally located in foreground-middle; small neighbors and town extend behind it. Hero visible full-body and face, grounded at real resident scale, never an enormous mascot pasted outside the world. Warm ivory home with a recognizable round blue door, round window and rose/yellow/blue broad scalloped roof tiles, now generously developed with porch, upper room, side greenhouse and planted garden. Other buildings smaller: one little shop, waterwheel workshop, park, distant harbor and small observatory. A few cream rabbit / brown otter / orange fox residents visibly sit, carry a basket, use the park, or greet the hero. Lots to discover but deliberate calm pockets; do not use dozens of indistinct houses. Real connected walkable paths and bridges.
Three alternatives: LEFT A: home-centered garden town, winding path from foreground house into a layered neighborhood, single continuous broad asymmetrical island with one sandy cove. MIDDLE B: home beside a narrow clear stream, workshop wheel and bridge connect garden to harbor, continuous land. RIGHT C: home overlooking a curved crescent bay, harbor town following coast, home still largest visual anchor.
Art: exceptionally charming polished stylized 3D miniature world, handcrafted material distinctions: woven plush residents ONLY, painted wood homes, ceramic roof tiles, soft short grass, stone shores, transparent water. Strong clean silhouettes, beautiful tactile detail, bright daylight, crisp readable full-depth scene, warm lights limited to architectural accents. Not all made of wool. Sophisticated vivid blue/teal and purple with warm pink/yellow accents. Each panel at similar camera elevation, no aerial map so high that faces disappear, no excessive bokeh. No confetti, floating icons, excessive sparkles, gold palace, weapons. All structures have believable grounded doors and paths. This is an exploratory concept board, not implementation evidence.

Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE standalone portrait 2:3 premium key visual, no panels, no text or UI. This is the MATURE stage of a future growth sequence for Pokomoko, a children's learning world. Evolve the LEFT direction in input 1, but correct its cropped island and excessively cramped tall framing. Input 2 is the exact bear identity, input 3 is the original world material reference only.
Camera: a fixed three-quarter elevated view of a SINGLE continuous asymmetrical island in vivid turquoise-blue sea. Show its complete front and side shoreline and enough ocean margin to understand an island, with back landscape extending toward horizon. The camera must allow the following initial/middle stages to keep the EXACT same scale, angle, house position and landmarks. Do NOT make three panels.
Composition: largest focal point is the player's warm cream home at lower center-left, facing camera, covering about 35% image width. It is level 5: familiar blue round-topped door, round crossbar window, broad rose-pink/yellow/cobalt scalloped roof tiles, porch, larger upstairs dormer, side glass greenhouse and generous garden. Keep it a lovable home, not a palace. Pokomoko stands on the path beside this door, full-body about 9% image height, recognizable cream-left/cobalt-right face, yellow seam, navy dotted left ear and pink dotted right ear, tiny friendly dark eyes and cream muzzle, striped cream/navy and yellow torso, teal/pink sleeves. Exact reference identity; hero must be integrated physically into the scene and the first character noticed, not a separate giant foreground portrait.
Keep a large purple flowering tree to the right of the home as a permanent anchor. A looping stone path behind home leads to a small shop upper-left, park upper-middle and waterwheel workshop upper-right; harbor at right shoreline with one boat and small lighthouse; a modest observatory at the far back as secondary distant landmark. Each neighborhood is legible and has air around it, only about 6 main buildings including home, not a dense unrelated town. Cove and sandy shore sweep around the front; a little original wooden dock at lower-left. Behind home are connected pieces of real land, not floating tiles or disconnected islets.
Warm visible small residents: a cream rabbit approaches home with flowers, an otter carries a wooden basket between shop and home, a fox rests in park. Tiny background activity never competes with hero. No human player controls; residents just live here. Home garden flowers, benches, lanterns are lush but do not cover paths. Architectural stone, painted wood, glass, ceramic tiles and grass have their own tactile material; only residents are plush woven fabric.
Style: sophisticated delightful handcrafted stylized 3D scene, rich sunny daylight, turquoise and cobalt water, clear lavender-purple canopies, warm cream buildings, rose and yellow localized accents. Shape language from reference 3, polished tactile richness from input 1. Strong sense of growing from a small house into a complete world. Keep clean calm path areas, no distracting confetti or sparkle field. Full-depth readable miniature landscape, no heavy bokeh. No signs with letters, typography, badges, random symbols, logos or watermark. Small neighboring offshore land can be hinted far away but no second primary island. Final is art-direction key visual, not a screenshot or UI.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference 1 into the INITIAL stage of this SAME island. Output one portrait 2:3 image same pixel framing as reference. Reference 2 is the exact hero face/material identity.
STRICT invariants: camera elevation, lens, angle, horizon at the same height, lighting, art style, ocean color, foreground dock's exact position and shape, foreground rock formation and shore, path to blue front door, home doorway ground location, Pokomoko's full body position/scale/pose and cream-left cobalt-right face yellow stitches dotted ears, and rabbit near home. Never zoom or reframe to fill empty space. Do not change the foreground resident identities. Keep the hero ivory not pink on its left face.
INITIAL world: remove all town development behind the home (shop, workshop, park fountain, observatory, lighthouse, harbor ship, other residents). The island initially ends behind the home garden; replace the farther developed districts with beautiful open blue sea at the SAME camera scale, a faint uninhabited distant natural shore is allowed but no architecture. Preserve the front little sandy island and its same dock. Reduce the same home to a SMALL appealing one-story cottage with its familiar same round blue door and round crossbar window and broad pink/yellow/blue scalloped roof; original home core identifiable, door exactly same place; remove greenhouse, upper side dormer extension, large terrace, lush climbing vines. Keep one little planter and one simple lamp. Roof and walls should be clearly smaller at same scale.
The purple tree to the right remains at EXACT same trunk/root location but is a much smaller young tree with a modest purple canopy. Garden has a small low flower bed, one plain bench, short simple wooden fence, stepping stones and broad inviting green grass, a few blossoms. Clean cheerful useful space, not barren or sad. Rabbit holds only a small flower; no new actions for the user. Same Pokomoko happily at home. This must read as the charming humble beginning of the mature reference, not an abandoned/ruined/destroyed version. No building ruins, scaffolding, gray desaturation, UI, text, logos, comparison panels or extra characters. Preserve material distinctions: plush hero, painted wood, ceramic roof, grass/stone/clear water. Same sunny crafted 3D aesthetic.

Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE portrait 2:3 key visual of the MIDDLE growth stage between reference 1 MATURE and reference 2 INITIAL. Reference 3 exact hero identity. Not a collage, no UI/text.
Use reference 1 as camera and world anchor: same elevated three-quarter angle, scale, foreground dock in same exact image coordinates, foreground rock formation, horizon, home door location, hero location and size, daylight. Same original cream home with round blue door and round crossbar window, pink/yellow/blue broad scalloped tile roof. Home now level 3: pleasant wooden porch and small upper dormer, fuller window boxes, but NO side greenhouse or large level-5 extension. Slightly more substantial than initial while recognizably the same core house. Hero is the exact same Pokomoko full-body at home entrance, cream-left/cobalt-right face yellow center seam, navy dotted left ear and pink dotted right ear, kind black bead eyes, ivory muzzle, turquoise/pink sleeves, cream/navy striped and yellow torso. Rabbit visits with a few flowers. Keep scale and position from mature reference, do not enlarge characters.
The connected island has grown BEHIND home to reach a charming small neighborhood: ONE modest shop at upper-left matching the mature shop's footprint but a simpler one-storey form, one small park with bench and low flower bed at the mature park's location, one winding walkable stone path leading there. An otter carries a basket toward home. Keep purple tree to right of home at exact same trunk location but mid-size canopy between the two references. There is clear open grassy space, not fully dense mature flower coverage.
Do NOT include the mature waterwheel workshop, lighthouse, observatory, large harbor or boat. Replace those future outer district areas with ocean, leaving one continuous irregular island with real sandy shore and low rock edge, intermediate between the small initial island and mature long island. No ruins, construction rubble, empty concrete plazas, blueprints or silhouettes of locked buildings. Future open water means future island extension, not demolition. Horizon stays fixed; sea and distant natural islands match reference.
Palette and materials exactly as mature: lush turquoise/cobalt sea, lavender-purple tree, warm cream painted wood, yellow/rose accents, ceramic roof, grass and stone, textile residents only. Beautiful inviting clear stylized 3D miniature art, believable paths/contact points and playful warmth, no excessive sparkle or bokeh. This must clearly communicate a family home becoming a neighborhood, with ample contrast to both endpoints. No panels, labels, text, mascot logos, UI or watermark.
